# GitHub Copilot instructions for Buyerly

For frontend or visual changes, `/docs/UI_CONTRACT.md` is mandatory and `/docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` supplies the product principles. Production semantic tokens live in `/frontend/src/styles/tokens.css` and shared React primitives live in `/frontend/src/ui/`; never create a second page-local button, input, select, dialog or status family. Public legal documents and assets live in `/frontend/public/`; the retired interface has been removed.
